images.description: Free, trial-eligible Omi owner reads their conversation summary for 3s+, then goes back. Left: the summary (same on both). Middle: main, Home with no paywall. Right: this change, the live trial arm's page slides up on Home with live prices (7 days free, then US$269.91/year). iPhone 17 Pro simulator.

The free allowance locks a new conversation (Pending, View Usage row). Left: the locked row. Middle: main, nothing else happens. Right: this change, the trial offer about 1s later. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
The reader opens the plans sheet themselves (the sheet the Processing paused Upgrade opens), closes it, then a conversation locks: no second paywall within 72h. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, this change.
Dark appearance: the summary, then the trial offer on Home (the trial page keeps its light canvas). iPhone 17 Pro simulator, this change.

This change, a 9s read: iOS shows its rating ask on the summary; after Back, Home still shows the rating ask and the trial offer is not stacked on it (the moment waits for a later session). iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
